scope: Search for a producer-authored ACAD_TABLE/DATALINK DWG witness and evaluate Autodesk's native authoring documentation as a possible scratch-sample generator route.

method.kind: Official API, user-guide, sample-index, and published peer-schema review

sources.observed: The official code sample obtains AcDbDataLinkManager from the working database, creates an AcExcel data link using a source file, sets persist-cache and update options, and attaches it to a selected table cell with AcDbTable::setDataLink(row, column, id, true).
sources.doesNotEstablish: No DWG bytes, exact NOD/extension-dictionary/owner/TABLECONTENT graph, target-version compatibility, or serialized reference roles are provided.

sources.observed: The user-facing documentation describes XLS/XLSX/CSV sources, full/relative/no-path choices, whole-sheet/named-range/rectangular-range selections, and PASTESPEC as a route to a linked AutoCAD table.
sources.doesNotEstablish: The docs do not prove the ObjectARX example supports every UI option identically or define the wire graph.

sources.observed: The sample index lists Imperial and Metric Blocks and Tables drawings.
sources.doesNotEstablish: No DATALINK presence is identified. The previously inspected local metric sample has TABLE parse failures and no verified DATALINK owner/range census, so its filename and TABLE presence are insufficient.

sources.observed: The published object schema inventories DATALINK fields including hardowner and custom-data records, and describes TABLECONTENT nested payload structures.
sources.doesNotEstablish: It is not an independent producer artifact, does not establish the exact owner/root path, and cannot be the sole authority for LibreDWG-generated bytes.

readiness: No public positive DATALINK-bearing DWG with independently verifiable owner/range expectations was found in this search.
At a one-time authorized native checkpoint, create a minimal scratch source workbook and linked table through the documented ObjectARX path, save and native-reopen the DWG, and hash all artifacts.
Inventory DATALINK, TABLE, TABLECONTENT, owner, NOD, extension-dictionary, and cache/reference edges before making parser or writer claims.
Do not install or license AutoCAD/ObjectARX during an ordinary implementation slice; if no authorized host exists, report NOT_RUN and keep linked TABLE export fail-closed.
